portada.texto: Your documents never leave your device: everything is processed here, in your browser.
portada.soltar: or drop a PDF, .docx, .xlsx or .pptx file here
portada.sueltaAqui: Drop the file to open it

barra.panel: Show or hide the side panel
barra.tema: Switch between light and dark mode

anotar.boton: Annotate: highlight, comment, draw and stamp
anotar.guardar: Save the PDF with the annotations
anotar.descartar: There are unsaved annotations. They will be lost if you open another document.
anotar.error: The change could not be made to the document.
anotar.errorGuardar: The document could not be saved.

clave.texto: This PDF is password protected. Enter the password to open it.

errores.noEsPdf: That file is not a PDF or a .docx, .xlsx or .pptx document.
errores.abrir: The document could not be opened. It may be damaged.
errores.motor: The PDF engine is not available.

actualizador.descargando: Downloading and installing… the app will restart by itself.
actualizador.alDia: You already have the latest version.
actualizador.errorComprobar: Could not check for a new version. Is there an internet connection?
actualizador.errorInstalar: The update could not be installed. Please try again later.

ajustes.avisar: Notify on startup when a new version is available

organizar.boton: Organise pages: move, rotate, delete, merge and split
organizar.pista: Tap or click to pick pages (Ctrl or Shift for several). Drag them to change the order; on mobile, press and hold, then drag.
organizar.insertarArchivo: Insert pages from another PDF or images
organizar.extraer: Save the chosen pages as a new PDF
organizar.confirmarBorrar: Delete the selected pages? You can undo it.
organizar.error: The page change could not be made.
organizar.errorTodas: You cannot delete every page: a PDF needs at least one.
organizar.errorProtegido: One of the PDFs has a password: open it first and save it without one.
organizar.crearTexto: They are joined in this order. Use the arrows to change it.
organizar.rangosMal: A range is not clear. Use numbers and dashes: 1-3, 5, 8-10
organizar.rangosFuera: A range goes past the end of the document (it has {total} pages).
organizar.recortarTexto: Drag over the page to mark what you want to keep.

firmar.boton: Sign: handwritten, with certificate or check signatures
firmar.guardadas: Your saved signatures (tap one to use it)
firmar.pistaDibujar: Sign with your finger, pen or mouse.
firmar.pistaSubir: Take a photo of your signature on white paper: the background is removed automatically.
firmar.fotoVacia: No signature found in the photo. Try with more light and white paper.
firmar.errorFoto: The image could not be read.
firmar.tocaParaColocar: Tap the page where you want to place the signature.
firmar.certPrivacidad: Use your .p12 or .pfx certificate. The certificate and its password are used only on this device and are never stored.
firmar.certVisible: Visible signature: tap the page to place the box
firmar.tocaRecuadro: Tap the page where you want the signature box.
firmar.errClave: The certificate password is not correct.
firmar.errP12: That file is not a valid .p12 or .pfx certificate.
firmar.errSinClave: The certificate has no private key: export it including the key.
firmar.errCaducado: The certificate has expired and cannot be used to sign.
firmar.errGrande: The certificate is too large to sign with.
firmar.errFirmar: The document could not be signed.
firmar.errVerificar: The signatures could not be checked.
firmar.verNinguna: This document has no digital signatures.
firmar.verValida: Valid signature: the document has not changed since it was signed
firmar.verRota: INVALID signature: the document was changed or the signature is damaged
firmar.verDesconocida: This signature could not be checked (unsupported format)
firmar.verConfianza: Certificate from a recognised Spanish authority (FNMT or DNIe).
firmar.verSinConfianza: The certificate is not from an authority DNNS PDF recognises: check who issued it.
firmar.verCambiosDespues: Changes were added to the document after this signature (for example, another signature).
firmar.verNota: The file is checked as it was opened. Certificate revocation is not checked.
firmar.avisoFirmas: This document has digital signatures ({total}) and they are fine. Details in Sign › Check signatures.
firmar.avisoFirmasRotas: Warning! A signature in this document is not valid. See Sign › Check signatures.

oficina.convertido: Converted to PDF. Use Download to save it as a PDF.
oficina.error: The document could not be converted.
oficina.filasOmitidas: … and {total} more rows that do not fit in the PDF
